I don't have the function yet — point me at it (file path, or paste it) and I'll do it.

One thing to flag up front, since it changes what you'll get: this project's standing rule is that comments stay concise and explain the *why* in a line or two, scoped to the surrounding code. So I won't write a line-by-line narration of every statement — that ages badly and mostly restates code that already says what it does. What I will do for a genuinely tricky function:

- A short block comment at the top covering the invariant/contract and why the approach is what it is.
- Inline notes at the actual non-obvious points — the ordering constraints, the edge cases, the "this looks wrong but isn't" spots, the reasons behind any workaround.
- Nothing on the steps that read plainly on their own.

That should get a future reader everything they can't recover from the code itself. If you specifically want the exhaustive step-by-step version anyway — say, for a teaching doc or a walkthrough rather than the source file — tell me and I'll write it that way, or put the long-form explanation in a separate doc and keep the source comments tight.
